newsitem.title: ESTONIA: KIVITER TO BE OFFERED FOR SALE AGAIN.
newsitem.headline: KIVITER TO BE OFFERED FOR SALE AGAIN.

text.p: The Estonian privatization agency on Wednesday decided to put oil shale chemical company Kiviter up for sale for the second time.
In March, Kiviter's first privatiszation round failed because the agency and the winner of the first round, Infravest, could not reach agreement on environmental concerns and the price of oil shale.
Kiviter is one of the largest companies in north eastern Estonia. Its sales in 1996 were 938 million kroons and it employed 3,500 people.
"We will try to decrease the possibility of failure to reach an agreement," Vaino Sarnet, director of the privatization agency, told a news conference.
The agency will prepare the text of a new agreement by June, Sarnet said.
